SELECT dt::date AS date,
    to_char(dt, 'Day'::text) AS day,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM dt)::bigint * '-1'::integer AS daterank,
    to_char(dt, 'Month-YYYY'::text) AS month,
    EXTRACT(month FROM dt)::integer AS month_no,
    EXTRACT(year FROM dt)::integer AS year,
    (EXTRACT(year FROM dt)::integer * 100 + EXTRACT(month FROM dt)::integer) * '-1'::integer AS yearkey,
    EXTRACT(dow FROM dt) AS weekday,
    dt::date -
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM dt) <= 6::numeric THEN (EXTRACT(dow FROM dt) - 1::numeric)::integer
            ELSE (EXTRACT(dow FROM dt) - 8::numeric)::integer
        END AS start_of_week,
    dt::date -
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM dt) <= 6::numeric THEN (EXTRACT(dow FROM dt) - 1::numeric)::integer
            ELSE (EXTRACT(dow FROM dt) - 8::numeric)::integer
        END + 6 AS end_of_week
   FROM generate_series('2022-09-30'::date::timestamp with time zone, (CURRENT_DATE - 1)::timestamp with time zone, '1 day'::interval) dt(dt);
